# -> MintOrBurn.com Weekly Lottery <- 

import con_mintorburn as mob

random.seed()

owner = Variable()
active = Variable()

pot_amount = Variable()
entry_amount = Variable()

lottery_candidates = Variable()

@construct
def seed():
    owner.set(ctx.caller)

    pot_amount.set(0)
    entry_amount.set(0)

    active.set(False)

@export
def resetLottery(initial_pot: float, single_entry: float):
    assert active.get() == False, 'Need to execute finishLottery() first'

    error = 'Only the owner can reset the lottery'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error

    pot_amount.set(initial_pot)
    entry_amount.set(single_entry)
    lottery_candidates.set([])

    mob.transfer_from(amount=initial_pot, to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller)

    active.set(True)

@export
def fundLottery(amount: float):
    assert active.get() == True, 'Lottery not active'

    mob.transfer_from(amount=amount, to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller)
    pot_amount.set(pot_amount.get() + amount)

@export
def joinLottery():
    assert active.get() == True, 'Lottery not active'

    mob.transfer_from(amount=entry_amount.get(), to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller)
    pot_amount.set(pot_amount.get() + entry_amount.get())
    
    candidates = lottery_candidates.get()
    candidates.append(ctx.caller)
    lottery_candidates.set(candidates)

@export
def finishLottery():
    assert active.get() == True, 'Lottery not active'

    error = 'Only the owner can finish the lottery'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error

    candidates = lottery_candidates.get()

    error = 'Can not finish lottery without players'
    assert len(candidates) > 0, error

    randomInt = random.randint(0, len(candidates) - 1)
    winner = candidates[randomInt]

    mob.transfer(amount=pot_amount.get(), to=winner)

    pot_amount.set(0)
    active.set(False)

    return f"{winner}"

@export
def setOwner(address: str):
    error = 'Only the current owner can set a new owner'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error

    owner.set(address)
